title: Stacking experiment: BIR out-of-fold prediction as an extra earth input column
description: Evaluation-only study. Add eval_stacking.R driver plus a bir_oof_feature() out-of-fold helper in eval_common.R, and a new section 10 in BIR-evaluation-results.md. For Boston, synthetic_large, solubility: build x_augmented = [x || bir_pred] where bir_pred is BIR's default affinity_lasso prediction generated OUT-OF-FOLD (K-fold cross-fit on train, single full-train fit for test), fit the original degree-2 earth on it, and report OOS-R2/RMSE for (a) plain earth, (b) stacked earth, (c) BIR alone, plus whether MARS selected the bir_pred term (evimp). No bucketimpute/R/* changes.
steps: Add bir_oof_feature() to inst/eval/eval_common.R (K-fold cross-fit train column, single full-train test column, reproducible seed scheme).
Add inst/eval/eval_stacking.R driver (per-dataset invocation, K and budget args, evimp inspection, machine-readable STACK_ROW/STACK_USE output).
Run boston (K=5), synthetic (K=5), solubility-full (K=3, budget) as separate timed invocations; smoke first.
Write section 10 in BIR-evaluation-results.md with (a)/(b)/(c) table, bir_pred variable-importance finding, honest verdicts, seed/K scheme, cost.

results.spam: expected BIR failure at distinct-buckets step; not evaluated

findings.verdict: One clear win (Boston, +0.068 R2, term selected), two neutral results (synthetic and solubility, MARS drops the term so stacked == baseline). No leakage: bir_pred is out-of-fold. Eval-only; no package R code changed.
findings.environment: R 4.5.3 on Amazon Linux 2023, packages from /projects/sandbox/.Rcache (R_LIBS). solubility-full ~560s with K=3.
